### 📱 How to Import to Kindle

#### Method 1: Email to Kindle (Recommended)
1. **Get your Kindle email address**:
   - Go to Amazon.com → Your Account → Manage Your Content and Devices
   - Click on "Devices" tab
   - Find your Kindle device and note the email address (e.g., `yourname@kindle.com`)

2. **Email the EPUB file**:
   - Attach `Harnessing_AI_for_Performance_Optimization_Kindle_Ready.epub` to an email
   - Send it to your Kindle email address
   - Subject: "Convert" (this ensures proper conversion)
   - The book will appear on your Kindle within a few minutes

#### Method 2: USB Transfer
1. Connect your Kindle to your computer via USB
2. Copy the EPUB file to the "Documents" folder on your Kindle
3. Safely eject your Kindle
4. The book will appear in your library

#### Method 3: Kindle App
1. Open the Kindle app on your phone/tablet
2. Use the "Send to Kindle" feature
3. Upload the EPUB file
4. The book will sync across all your devices
